description: This PHP source file defines the class ImportMapSalesforce, which extends ImportMapOther, providing specific mapping configurations for importing Salesforce.com data into the application. It includes methods to retrieve field mappings for different modules ('Contacts', 'Leads', 'Accounts') and specifies certain import settings like delimiter, enclosure, and header presence.

classes.name: ImportMapSalesforce
classes.description: Handles Salesforce-specific import mappings, extending the base ImportMapOther class, and provides custom field mapping logic for specific modules.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Returns the appropriate field mappings for a specified module ('Contacts', 'Leads', 'Accounts'). Overrides parent method to add Salesforce-specific field mappings.

methods.name: getIgnoredFields
methods.description: Returns fields to be ignored during import for a given module, including the 'id' field.
